title: SREV-191 Named pipe pending I/O lifetime contract
contracts: NamedPipeServer owns service-side pending NtReadFile and NtWriteFile lifetime for proxied named-pipe handles
A caller-supplied IO_STATUS_BLOCK passed to NtReadFile or NtWriteFile must remain valid until the operation completes
A transfer buffer passed to NtReadFile or NtWriteFile must remain valid until the operation completes
STATUS_PENDING requires waiting for I/O completion before trusting the final IO_STATUS_BLOCK
CancelIo requests cancellation but does not prove that the canceled operation has completed
The timeout path must wait for completion after requesting cancellation before returning STATUS_CANCELLED with zero transfer bytes
A reused per-handle event must be reset before each native I/O issue
Only one native read write or set operation may use a proxied named-pipe handle event at a time
The per-handle I/O lock is owned by PROXY_PIPE lifetime and released by CloseCallback
LPC and ALPC proxy handles do not own a named-pipe I/O lock and are outside this contract
runtime proof is required on Windows for timeout cancellation and concurrent read write behavior
runtime_gate: Windows SbieSvc build plus named-pipe read write concurrent same-handle timeout cancel and blocked-peer smoke proving no stale event wrong completion stack corruption nonzero timeout payload or service-wide deadlock
